text:
jen: Heads up — I'm seeing a weird invoice-preview spike for a small set of EU tenants after yesterday's route-resolver rollout. numbers look like +3-4% tokens on preview, not on final invoice.

david: which route-resolver change? the one that added `route_resolution.v2` fingerprinting?

jen: yup. rolled 02:10 UTC. preview pipeline shows more events attributed to `fallback` route for 10s window. production invoices (finalized) don't match preview.

maya: can you paste a sample event?

jen: here's an anonymized snippet from preview logs:

```
{event_id: "evt_9xx", ts: 1688245987, tenant: "eu-rc1", route_resolution: null, token_count: 124}
```

jen: Those route_resolution fields are null in preview, but finalization shows `route_resolution_id: rsv2-abc123` for the same session id.

metering-bot: noticed 87 preview events with `route_resolution=null` from 8245980000..8245990000, routed to `fallback` consumer.

alan: hypothesis: preview branch reads from the shadow topic (pre-enrichment) while finalizer reads enriched topic. route-resolver v2 moved enrichment earlier, so timing mismatch.

jen: that matches. preview consumes from streaming-preview and we added lightweight enrichment in the finalizer consumer path.

david: so preview lacks route tags for a short window -> those tokens counted as generic fallback SKU in the preview UI. actual invoice gets corrected when finalizer enriches and attributes tokens.

maya: two questions: 1) are customers actually billed incorrectly? 2) how noisy is the console? product team saw support tickets.

jen: customers not billed incorrectly yet. preview is just misleading and our console shows per-route breakdown that support quoted.

alan: can we patch preview to apply the same enrichment as finalizer? maybe run the resolver as a light pass in the preview consumer (idempotent).

metering-bot: rollout note: `route-resolver v2` propagated to eu region at 8245980000. Preview lag 8s on avg; enrichment moved to post-ingest at 8245991000 for finalizer.

david: quick mitigation: add a note in console UI when preview window overlaps route-resolver rollouts. UX sticky, but we should also prioritize fixing pipeline.

maya: agree. small change: add a flag `preview_consistent_with_finalizer` to the preview card, value boolean + tooltip describing race windows.

jen: ops mitigation in progress: reconfigure preview consumer to consume from the enriched topic for a rolling 30m canary. will flip flag once stable.

alan: long term we should ensure enrichment is part of the earliest ingest stage or make preview replicate finalization logic exactly. also consider tagging events with `inflight_flag` so the console knows an event might be reattributed later.

david: can we detect this without changing topology? e.g., compare `event.session_id` counts between preview and final every 1m and surface anomalies to a dashboard alert.

jen: I created a quick grafana panel: `preview_vs_final_attribution_delta` and a temporary alert threshold at 1% for EU clusters. link: https://grafana.internal/r/preview-delta-8246

metering-bot: alert firing: EU preview delta 2.6% at 8246000000.

maya: assign action items?

jen: action list: 1) jen - patch preview consumer to read enriched topic (canary) 2) alan - evaluate moving resolver earlier (infra impact) 3) david - console UX flag + tooltip 4) maya - draft support note and update runbook.

david: I'll prepare a short console CTA: "Preview may be inconsistent during routing rollouts — use invoice preview disclaimers". keep it lightweight.

maya: support note: include query to reconcile: `SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) FROM preview WHERE ts>t0 GROUP BY session_id` then join final.

alan: also add a lightweight ETL check: if `route_resolution is null AND final shows non-null` mark event as "post-enriched" in the ledger so invoices can be traced later.

jen: thanks. I'll start the canary now and post results in this thread.

sre-bot: deploy starting: preview-consumer-read-enriched v0.1 -> canary (eu). CI: green.

jen: canary up. initial delta dropped from 2.6% -> 0.4% in 5m. posting metrics in channel.

david: awesome. once we confirm 30m stability we can push UX flag and update support note.

meya: (typo) maya: noted. will draft doc.

jen: closing notes: no invoice issuance impacted, root cause is enrichment timing mismatch introduced by resolver v2 reorder. plan: keep enriched preview consumer until we redesign enrichment placement.

metering-bot: ticket created: MNTR-5243 "preview attribution race during route-resolver rollout" assigned to jen/alan.

alan: thanks all. please add any follow-ups to the ticket. :thumbsup:
